capability.summary: Inspect one PDF's page count and metadata preview
capability.description: Opens a single PDF path with pypdf PdfReader and returns its page count plus the first 300 characters of the string representation of document metadata; it performs no merge operation.
capability.problem_space: Basic structural inspection of one PDF when page count and a short metadata preview are sufficient.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one PDF path string despite the plural parameter name; output: JSON with pages integer and metadata string truncated to 300 characters.
accepted_inputs: one readable PDF file path accepted by pypdf PdfReader
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.pypdf_merge", pages as the PDF's integer page count, and metadata as the first at most 300 characters of str(PdfReader.metadata). A caught file-open, encryption, PDF-parse, page-access, or metadata exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.pypdf_merge", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: does not merge, split, rotate, rewrite, or output PDFs despite the wrapper name and original label
accepts exactly one path string; it does not parse a list of pdf_paths
metadata is flattened with str and truncated to 300 characters rather than returned as structured fields
returns JSON metadata rather than a PDF artifact even though the manifest artifact_type remains structurally unchanged
encrypted, malformed, missing, and unreadable PDFs use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: JSON-wrapped page count and a 300-character PDF metadata preview; no PDF is created or modified.

negative_intents: split rotate or rewrite PDF pages
